facts.opening: Let your AI search the library and cite timestamps.
facts.youtube: Capture YouTube videos with transcripts, frames, and comments.
facts.podcasts: Save X posts and videos, podcasts, articles, and Reddit threads.
facts.storage: Keep everything on your disk as Markdown + JSON, with a local search index.
facts.search: search no longer requires every word. search_library, search_uoinks, and search_clips take optional match ("forgiving" by default, "strict" to require every word) and mode ("auto" by default, "keyword", "semantic", "hybrid"); find_mentions takes match. Auto uses hybrid when semantic search is ready, otherwise keyword; each response says which mode ran. Quote a passage only when passage_verified is true.
facts.browser: ChatGPT and claude.ai: copy and paste only; Uoink does not connect to the ChatGPT app over MCP.
facts.platform: Windows 10/11, plus a Mac preview for Apple Silicon (macOS 15 or later).

pages.title: Cite YouTube timestamps in Claude
pages.sourceFact: Capture YouTube videos with transcripts, frames, and comments.
pages.description: Cite YouTube timestamps in Claude with Uoink. Let your AI search the library and cite timestamps.
pages.setup: Save a YouTube video, then connect Claude Desktop or Claude Code to Uoink.
pages.prompt: Find passages about YOUR_TOPIC in my saved YouTube videos. Get an evidence card for the source I choose and cite its timestamps.

pages.title: Search podcasts with AI
pages.sourceFact: Save X posts and videos, podcasts, articles, and Reddit threads.
pages.description: Search saved podcasts with Uoink and your AI. Let your AI search the library and cite timestamps.
pages.setup: Save a podcast, then connect your AI to Uoink.
pages.prompt: Search my saved podcasts for YOUR_TOPIC. Get an evidence card for the source I choose. Quote a passage only when passage_verified is true.
